description: This Java class defines a custom Akka HTTP directive that enforces HTTPS for proxied requests, with options for redirection or rejection based on configuration.

classes.name: HttpsEnsuringDirective
classes.description: A final class providing a directive to ensure requests are made via HTTPS, with optional redirection or rejection.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of HttpsEnsuringDirective with provided HTTP configuration.

methods.name: ensureHttps
methods.description: Wraps a route to enforce HTTPS, redirecting or rejecting non-HTTPS requests based on configuration.

methods.name: getForwardedProtoHeaderOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves the 'X-Forwarded-Proto' header value from the request, checking standard and LBaaS-specific headers.

methods.name: handleNonHttpsRequest
methods.description: Handles requests that are not via HTTPS, redirecting or rejecting based on configuration.

methods.name: isBlocked
methods.description: Checks if the request URI path matches a blocklist pattern for redirection.

methods.name: redirectToHttps
methods.description: Creates a redirect route to HTTPS URI with a 301 status.

methods.name: disallowRequest
methods.description: Creates a route that responds with 404 Not Found and an error message for non-HTTPS requests.
